Your favorite Dr. Seuss books are now interactive apps for your iPad and iPhone!

Use this catalog to find the perfect Dr. Seuss apps to fit your needs and budget. Tap the app icons in the catalog to go directly to the App Store!

Learn about these award-winning Dr. Seuss book apps:
- Dr. Seuss Treasury
- Dr. Seuss Treasury - School Edition
- The Cat In The Hat - Read & Learn
- The Lorax - Read & Play
- Green Eggs And Ham - Read & Learn
- How The Grinch Stole Christmas! - Read & Play 
- Dr. Seuss's Abc - Read & Learn
- Horton Hears A Who! - Read & Play
- One Fish Two Fish Red Fish Blue Fish - Read & Learn
- Hop On Pop - Read & Learn
- Fox In Socks - Read & Learn
- Oh, The Places You’ll Go! - Read & Play
- Dr. Seuss — Read, Learn & Play — Book Bundle
- Dr. Seuss — Read & Learn — Beginner Book Bundle

App Features:
- READ ALONG with highlighting narration, read it yourself, or enjoy auto play
- LEARN new vocabulary with tappable words and pictures
- SELECT a scene with easy-to-use navigation
- AND MORE!
